description_en: Adds shared accounts for a service
description_zh: 调用AddServiceSharedAccounts新增服务的共享账号
kebab_example: aliyun computenestsupplier add-service-shared-accounts --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --shared-accounts UserAliUid=123456 Permission=Accessible --service-id service-63b8a060e9d54cxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddServiceSharedAccounts

parameters.help_en: A unique identifier that you provide to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot be longer than 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en:
The permission type. Valid values:

Deployable: The service can be deployed.

Accessible: The service can be accessed
fields.help_zh:
权限类型。可能的值：

Deployable：可部署。

Accessible：可访问
fields.name: permission

fields.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account
fields.name: user_ali_uid

parameters.help_en: The shared accounts and their permissions
parameters.name: shared_accounts

parameters.help_en:
The service sharing type. The default value is SharedAccount. Valid values:

SharedAccount: The service is shared with a specified account.

Reseller: The service is shared with a reseller
parameters.help_zh:
服务共享类型，默认值为SharedAccount。可选值：

SharedAccount：普通共享类型。

Reseller：分销共享类型
parameters.name: type
